findings.title: Pending registry dead key composes a disabled row using selected-layout text
findings.confidence: high source routing; native delivery unexecuted
findings.root_cause: Pending criterion bypasses row switch; callback checks global base only before selected-layout emit.

reproduction.native_layout_assumption: US SC012 resolves e; no DLL/native execution

findings.silence: Supported row setting is accepted; incorrect text is emitted through the ordinary success path without a diagnostic.
findings.test_gap: Existing tests call PressNative with global base off or check neutral row criteria, not the registered pending callback with one row off.
findings.regression_direction: Exercise original registered callback with pending state, global base on, top row off and actual installed US HKL; retain neutral/enabled/Shift controls.
limitations: Source/data proof, not AutoHotkey runtime or Windows delivery.

deduplicated.reason: Legacy DeadKey named-control modifier loss already included.
Registry pause persistence already reported as policy hypothesis.
